author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Pickle a python configuration, optionally compressing it with zlib or zstd. The pickled configuration can be written to a binary blob, or encoded with base64 into a self-contained python configuration.

By default the pickle is compressed with zstd (level 6) and encoded with base64 into a self-contained python configuration, written to standard output.
```
Usage: edmConfigPickle [-#] [-z | -s] [-b | -p] [-o FILE] config.py [args ...]

Positional arguments:
  config.py             python configuration file
  args ...              arguments passed to the python configuration file while
                        it is loaded (see below)

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -#                    compression level, between 1 and 9 for zlib and between
                        1 and 19 for zstd, or 0 to leave the pickle uncompressed
                        (default: 6)
  -z, --zlib            compress with zlib
  -s, --zstd            compress with zstd (default)
  -b, --base64          encode with base64 and write a self-contained python
                        configuration (default)
  -p, --pickle          write the (compressed) pickle as a binary file, without
                        base64 encoding
  -o, --output FILE     write the output to FILE instead of standard output; use
                        "-o -" to write a binary pickle to standard output

The arguments after config.py are passed to the configuration while it is loaded, as with "cmsRun config.py args" or "edmConfigDump config.py args": their effect is stored in the pickled configuration, and they are only recorded in a comment at the beginning of the output. Any arguments given to cmsRun when running the pickled configuration are ignored: to change them, run edmConfigPickle again with the new arguments.
```

#### PR validation:

The new unit tests pass.
title: Implement `edmConfigPickle` and its unit test
